text:
maya: Heads-up — running a small PLG experiment next week: 45-minute demo + prompt lab webinar, paired with a 100-credit free trial drip and a downloadable "Prompt Starter Pack". Goal: move seed users from signup -> first meaningful request within 48h. :rocket:

sam: Love it. What's the hypothesis & key metric? Conversion to MMR? or first-run rate?

maya: Hypothesis: adding immediate, runnable prompt templates + modest credits will bump first-run rate by 20-30% vs baseline. Primary metric = % of new signups that make >=1 generate call within 48h. Secondary: retention at day7.

olivia: Ops q: where do inbound webinar signups route? We should pipe them into the special "credit-lab" cohort so they get the 100 credits + prompt pack automatically.

sam: Can we use the existing webhook flow (growth-webhooks) and tag utm_campaign=credit-cadence? I can add a route to the cohort in the CRM. Also want to flag enterprise emails to exclude credits.

chris: I'll put together 3 quick launch-post variants + a benchmark narrative doc for the blog. One will be technical (latency/cost benchmark), one producty (prompt templates walkthrough), one community (open models + examples). Quick mockups: https://figma.com/s/credit-lab-mock (preview) :mag_right:

aaron: Suggest A/B on credit amount (100 vs 200) and another arm with a short guided onboarding in the console that highlights the prompt templates. Keep sample size small: ~400 signups per arm to be practical.

maya: Good call. Keep the main launch message focused on "Get 100 credits & Prompt Starter Pack — attend live or watch on-demand". We'll target devs on X and partner newsletters.

sam: For tracking: include utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=organic or paid, utm_campaign=credit-lab and a query param prompt_pack=starter. Also create a lightweight event in Amplitude: "webinar_signup" and "credit_claimed".

olivia: I'll handle the automation: signup -> send credits via promo API (/v1/internal/promos/issue) -> email with download link + CTA to run a sample prompt. Need the exact promo code & templates by EOD Thursday.

chris: Drafted short launch copy in thread: "Join our Prompt Lab — get credits to try Redwood inference workflows, runnable templates, and live troubleshooting". I'll post three social variations tomorrow AM.

maya: Final checklist: 1) copy & socials (chris) 2) promo code & automation (olivia) 3) webhook + cohort routing (sam) 4) Figma assets + blog benchmark (chris) 5) experiment splits + Amplitude events (aaron/sam). Tag @here when assets are ready.

event-bot: Webinar scheduled: "Prompt Lab — Credit Cadence" on 2025-06-18 16:00 UTC. Registration page: https://redwood.ai/webinar/credit-lab

maya: Great — let's sync 10am PT tomorrow for a 20-min kickoff. :raised_hands:
